beats.text: An agent that can act can do damage.
beats.say: An agent that can act can also do damage: delete data, leak secrets, or spend real money. Guardrails limit what it is able to do.
Input guardrails check what goes in: block prompt injection hidden in web pages or documents, and refuse out-of-scope requests.
Give tools the least privilege: read-only by default, scoped credentials, and an allowlist of actions.

beats.text: Risky action? Ask a human first.
beats.say: For risky actions, like payments or deletions, pause and ask a human first.
Output guardrails check what comes out: validate formats, redact private data, and block unsafe content before the user sees it.
Add hard limits too: maximum steps, a budget, and a time limit. And log everything, so you can audit what the agent did.
